title: MoMA PS1

services.name: Space Rentals
services.desc: MoMA PS1 has the charm of a 100-year-old, 125,000 sq. ft Romanesque Revival school building and the flair of an experimental contemporary art museum. Located in Long Island City, Queens, easily accessible one minute from the subway, PS1 offers a wide variety of indoor and outdoor spaces perfect for large and small events, from intimate receptions to large performances and presentations for up to 3,000 guests. At MoMA PS1, interaction with art is not confined to our gallery spaces. Moving through our staircases and corridors brings unexpected moments that imbue creativity into the experience of any event. blurb: Artist-centered and community-driven, MoMA PS1 embraces boundary-breaking ideas and experimental practices. A place where audiences can encounter and engage with new art and perspectives, the institution has offered insight into artists’ worldviews for nearly 50 years.
